authorizationBasis.projectDirective: Complete the full MouldMaster Book evidence, qualification, runtime-parity and publication-governance pass.

runtimeIntegrity.scope: Exact served bytes for every payload that can influence Book publication promotion or its independent-SME status. Git object identity is checked in-browser before JSON parsing; any mismatch fails closed.

publicationBoundaries: Verified means the generic governed Book wording passed the MouldMaster evidence and publication gates; it does not make generic guidance a machine, material, mould, hot-runner, product or site-specific instruction.
The 21 qualified claims retain their applicability, exclusions and non-universal scope exactly as reviewed.
Grade-specific processing values require current grade-specific manufacturer evidence and are not created by this authorization.
Machine, controller, mould, hot-runner and site safety procedures remain controlled by the applicable manufacturer and workplace documentation.
Troubleshooting remains hypothesis-and-evidence based; verification does not convert diagnostic possibilities into guaranteed causes or fixes.
Peer-reviewed learner-facing links use canonical DOI/publisher records where available; discovery indexes are not treated as the controlling citation target.

Worked engineering examples are synthetic teaching data with explicit assumptions and evidence anchors; they are not measured production evidence, universal settings, independent SME approval or machine-control authority.

Evidence-enrichment sections are exact-byte authorized generic teaching content recovered from the previously validated editorial stack; source-specific values retain source context, synthetic examples remain labelled, and independent human SME review remains a separate HOLD.
Any later hold, conflicting evidence, stale controlling source, read/listen divergence, byte-integrity mismatch or claim-ledger regression must fail closed and block/revoke publication in release QA.

workedCasesAuthorization.scope: Synthetic worked engineering teaching cases with explicit assumptions, units, evidence anchors and non-universal applicability boundaries.
workedCasesAuthorization.authorityBoundary: advisory-only; no validated recipe or automatic machine-control authority

evidenceEnrichmentAuthorization.scope: Evidence-backed Book enrichment across 10 existing chapters, including maintenance/recovery, hot-runner observability, cooling diagnosis, contamination reasoning, pressure loss, process-window robustness, warpage discrimination, process monitoring and ISO 9001:2026 quality-record discipline.
evidenceEnrichmentAuthorization.authorityBoundary: advisory-only; no universal setpoints, validated recipe authority or automatic machine control
